facts.fact: A two-year programme in eight drought-affected districts, financed through China's Global Development and South-South Cooperation Fund and managed by the government with UNICEF, is expected to support the digitisation and solarisation of civil registry offices and strengthen birth registration systems; no budget figure is given.

On 7 August 2026 a Chinese-funded, UNICEF-partnered two-year programme was launched at Kowoyo Clinic, Goromonzi, covering eight districts and expected to support the digitisation and solarisation of civil registry offices; the document does not say how many offices or what the digitised office will do.
